brief: The combined duration of all native module calls observed during the lifetime of the span, in milliseconds. Only applies to React Native.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.module.*` namespace, which also covers native module calls made over the Old Architecture bridge, and which drops the `total_` prefix and `_ms` suffix in favor of dot-separated logical grouping

changelog.description: Added turbo_module.total_duration_ms and deprecated it in favor of react_native.module.duration.total
